messages:
maria: noticed p95 jump for tenant acme after canary swap at 09:42 UTC. p50 ok, p95 ~ 430ms -> was 120ms. p99 also up. Affects /v1/generate primarily.
alex: which canary? id? do we have rollout id and percent?
jordan: canary id: runtime-v2.8.0-sched, rolled to 20% at 09:40.
maria: sample request id: req_4f2a3b, logs show queueing at scheduler layer. snippet below.
```text
[09:42:11] scheduler.enqueue request=req_4f2a3b depth=12
[09:42:11] kvcache.lock request=req_4f2a3b wait_ms=38
[09:42:11] runtime.exec start req_4f2a3b
[09:42:11] runtime.exec end req_4f2a3b latency_ms=420
```
kyle: looks like batch flush policy changed in v2.8.0 -> larger max batch timeout. can reproduce with replay.
alex: can you paste the replay command?
maria: replay command:
```bash
./tools/replay --tenant acme --sample req_4f2a3b --rate 50
```
jordan: sanity check: no kernel/quant changes in this rollout, only scheduler/timer tweak.
infra-ops: triage checklist: 1) route acme to stable runtime 2) increase hotpath pool 3) collect profiles/heap and CPU stacks
maria: routed 100% of acme back to runtime-v2.7.9 at 09:55 UTC. immediate p95 dropped to ~130ms :thumbsup: 
alex: good mitigation. can we hotpatch scheduler config in v2.8 without full rollback? if it's a single param, we could.
kyle: hypothesis: batch.max_delay_ms default changed from 8->20ms in commit abc123, causing occasional large batches for short prompts -> tail. need bisect.
jordan: spinning up bisect job to replay commits between abc100..abc200 against synthetic workload. ETA ~25m.
support-bot: notified acme and updated INC-1245 with rollback and mitigation steps.
maria: can we also add routing override to prefer stable for acme until fix is verified?
infra-ops: added routing tag override acme->runtime-v2.7.9 at 09:58 UTC (route-id: rt-9012).
alex: once bisect root cause confirmed, plan to cherry-pick revert + small canary (2%) then monitor.
kyle: repro locally: edit /etc/runtime/scheduler.conf set batch.max_delay_ms=20, run microbench and compare p95.
jordan: bisect finished: commit abc123 is the change (default 8->20ms). replay shows p95 regressed from 120ms->430ms for short sequences. opened PR #4287 to revert and add a config flag.
maria: rollout plan: PR -> cherry-pick -> canary @2% -> watch p95/p99 for 30m -> promote. if ok, promote and remove routing override.
alex: longer-term: implement adaptive batching that shrinks max_delay for high short-prompt ratio, add telemetry for batch sizes per tenant.
infra-ops: filing follow-up RFC: adaptive-batching (RFC-132).
maria: thanks all — will close thread after PR merge and canary verification. :white_check_mark:
